name: National Parks Georgia
summary:
VR Parks Georgia is an immersive virtual reality experience that takes you on a journey through the most remarkable national parks and protected areas of Georgia.

Explore the country’s diverse natural heritage, from majestic mountain ranges and lush forests to deep canyons, rivers, waterfalls, alpine meadows and rare wildlife habitats. Experience the hidden gems that make Georgia one of the most unique destinations for nature exploration.
